get_api_info.title: Get API information
get_api_info.description: Read the API's own information -- version and status. The cheapest unauthenticated-shaped call, useful as a reachability check.

get_account.title: Get the account
get_account.description: Read the account the API key belongs to, with its name and settings. The cheapest call that proves the credentials work.

list_shops.title: List shops
list_shops.description: Read the shops on the account. A shop id is what every contact call needs and what a new conversation must name, so start here.

list_users.title: List users
list_users.description: Read the agents on the account, with their ids and names. A user id is what assign_conversation takes.

list_teams.title: List teams
list_teams.description: Read the account's teams and their members. A team id is the other thing assign_conversation accepts, for handing a conversation to a group rather than a person.

create_team.title: Create a team
create_team.description: Create a team that conversations can be assigned to as a group.

delete_team.title: Delete a team
delete_team.description: Delete a team. Conversations assigned to it lose their assignee, so re-route anything open first.

output.description: Confirmation that the team was deleted.

list_conversations.title: List conversations
list_conversations.description: Read the account's conversations, newest first. Paginated with `limit` (max 100, default 50) and `skip`; each record carries its shop, channel, assignee and state.

limit.description: Conversations to return, up to 100. Defaults to 50.

skip.description: How many to skip, for paging.

get_conversation.title: Get a conversation
get_conversation.description: Read one conversation -- its channel, participants, assignee and state. Use list_conversation_items for the messages themselves.

from_date.description: Only include activity at or after this date.

to_date.description: Only include activity at or before this date.

list_conversation_items.title: List a conversation's messages
list_conversation_items.description: Read the items in a conversation -- the customer's messages, agent replies, internal notes and system events, in order. This is the actual transcript.

create_conversation.title: Start a conversation
create_conversation.description: Start a new conversation and send its first message. `channel` picks chat, email or phone; `to` names the customer -- by id or, for email, by address -- and `type` marks it as outbound, an auto-message, a follow-up or an inbound message you are recording. This sends something real.

shop_id.description: The shop the conversation belongs to, from list_shops.

type.description: What kind of message this is. Outbound, auto and follow-up messages go out to the customer; "inbound-message" records something they sent you, and "note" is internal.

subject.description: Subject line, for the email channel.

to.description: The recipient -- {"type": "customer", "_id": ...} or, for email, {"type": "customer", "email": ..., "firstName": ...}. Required for outbound, auto and follow-up messages.

from.description: The sender, e.g. {"type": "user", "_id": ...}. Only needed when recording an inbound message.

send_message.title: Send a message
send_message.description: Send a message, creating the conversation if the customer has none open. Takes the same fields as create_conversation and is the simpler call when you do not care whether a thread already exists.

shop_id.description: The shop the message belongs to.

type.description: What kind of message this is.

subject.description: Subject line, for the email channel.

output.description: The conversation the message was sent in.

reply_to_conversation.title: Reply to a conversation
reply_to_conversation.description: Send a reply into an existing conversation. The customer receives it over whatever channel the conversation uses, so it cannot be recalled.

body.description: The reply text sent to the customer.

add_note.title: Add an internal note
add_note.description: Add a note to a conversation for other agents. The customer never sees it, which makes this the safe way to record context.

body.description: The note text, visible only to agents.

output.description: The conversation after the note was added.

assign_conversation.title: Assign a conversation
assign_conversation.description: Hand a conversation to a user or a team. Pass `user_id` for a person or `team_id` for a group -- ids come from list_users and list_teams.

user_id.description: The agent to assign it to. Use this or `team_id`.

team_id.description: The team to assign it to. Use this or `user_id`.

unassign_conversation.title: Unassign a conversation
unassign_conversation.description: Take the assignee off a conversation, returning it to the unassigned queue.

close_conversation.title: Close a conversation
close_conversation.description: Mark a conversation resolved and take it out of the open inbox. A new customer message reopens it on its own.

reopen_conversation.title: Reopen a conversation
reopen_conversation.description: Put a closed conversation back in the open inbox.

snooze_conversation.title: Snooze a conversation
snooze_conversation.description: Hide a conversation from the inbox until a moment in the future -- the "chase this next week" action. `date` is a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

date.description: When to wake the conversation, as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

list_conversation_tags.title: List a conversation's tags
list_conversation_tags.description: Read the tags on one conversation, which is how Belco categorises contacts' issues.

add_conversation_tags.title: Add tags to a conversation
add_conversation_tags.description: Tag a conversation, which is what the reporting in get_conversation_metrics groups by. Existing tags are kept.

output.description: The conversation's tags after the change.

remove_conversation_tags.title: Remove tags from a conversation
remove_conversation_tags.description: Take tags off a conversation, leaving any others in place.

output.description: The conversation's tags after the change.

delete_conversation.title: Delete a conversation
delete_conversation.description: Delete a conversation and its whole transcript. Irreversible -- close it instead unless the record genuinely must go.

output.description: Confirmation that the conversation was deleted.

list_contacts.title: List a shop's contacts
list_contacts.description: Read the contacts in one shop. `email` and `phone_number` look one person up, and `type` separates customers who have ordered from leads and plain contacts.

email.description: Find the contact with this email address.

phone_number.description: Find the contact with this phone number.

skip.description: How many to skip, for paging.

get_contact.title: Get a contact
get_contact.description: Read one contact -- their details, order history summary, cart and tags. The context an agent needs before replying.

upsert_contact.title: Create or sync a contact
upsert_contact.description: Create a contact, or update the existing one with the same identifier. This is the sync endpoint: `id` is your own id for the person, and `cart`, `order_count` and `total_spent` are what make Belco's shop context useful to agents. Phone numbers are normalised to E.164.

shop_id.description: The shop the contact belongs to.

id.description: Your own id for this person, which is what makes this an upsert.

name.description: Full name, when you do not have it split.

phone_number.description: Phone number; normalised to E.164, defaulting to NL when no country code is given.

phone_numbers.description: Several phone numbers. Requires `phone_number` to be empty.

type.description: Whether this person is a customer, a lead or a plain contact.

signed_up.description: When they signed up, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

order_count.description: How many orders they have placed.

total_spent.description: Lifetime spend, in the shop's currency.

cart.description: Their current basket, e.g. {"currency": "EUR", "total": 49.9, "items": [{"id": ..., "name": ..., "price": ..., "quantity": 1}]}. Send null to empty it.

tags.description: Tags to set on the contact.

company.description: The company they belong to, e.g. {"id": ..., "name": ..., "email": ...}.

list_contact_conversations.title: List a contact's conversations
list_contact_conversations.description: Read every conversation one contact has had, which is the history an agent wants before answering a repeat question.

delete_contact.title: Delete a contact
delete_contact.description: Delete a contact and all their conversation history -- the GDPR erasure path. Irreversible.

output.description: Confirmation that the contact was deleted.

get_conversation_metrics.title: Get conversation metrics
get_conversation_metrics.description: Read conversation volumes and response times over a date range, grouped by team, shop, channel or assignee. `conversation_type` decides which timestamp the buckets are built from -- created, responded or closed.

assigned_to.description: Only conversations assigned to these users.

group_by.description: What to break the numbers down by.

conversation_type.description: Which timestamp the buckets are built from.

get_voice_metrics.title: Get voice metrics
get_voice_metrics.description: Read call volumes and outcomes for the account's phone numbers over a preset range or a custom window.

range.description: Preset window to report on. Use "custom" with `date` and `end_date`.

list_webhooks.title: List webhooks
list_webhooks.description: Read the account's webhook endpoints with the events each subscribes to and whether it is active.

get_webhook.title: Get a webhook
get_webhook.description: Read one webhook -- its url, event list, active state and signing secret.

create_webhook.title: Create a webhook
create_webhook.description: Register an endpoint for Belco events on one shop. Belco signs each delivery with an `x-hook-signature` header, so verify it on receipt.

shop_id.description: The shop whose events should be delivered.

url.description: HTTPS endpoint Belco should POST events to.

managed_by.description: A label naming the system that owns this webhook.

output.description: The created webhook, including its signing secret.

update_webhook.title: Update a webhook
update_webhook.description: Change a webhook's url, event list or active state.

events.description: The complete event list after the update.

activate_webhook.title: Activate a webhook
activate_webhook.description: Turn a paused webhook back on; deliveries resume from now, not retroactively.

deactivate_webhook.title: Deactivate a webhook
deactivate_webhook.description: Pause a webhook without deleting it. Events during the pause are not queued for later delivery.

delete_webhook.title: Delete a webhook
delete_webhook.description: Delete a webhook endpoint, losing its signing secret. Deactivate it instead if you may want it back.

output.description: Confirmation that the webhook was deleted.
